description: IBM Bob 2.0 lifecycle automation hooks for CodeArchaeologist

hooks.name: pre-refactor-blast-check
hooks.description: Simulates cascading blast radius and warns the developer if the target file impacts >3 API endpoints or has CRITICAL risk.

hooks.name: post-ingest-graph-refresh
hooks.description: Recomputes dependency graph with tsconfig path aliases and disambiguates call edges.

hooks.name: on-pr-review-impact-prediction
hooks.description: Runs ML change-impact predictor on all modified files in the git diff to flag co-change regressions.

hooks.name: evidence-grounded-qa
hooks.description: Invokes Reciprocal Rank Fusion over dense neural vectors and BM25 lexical tokens to retrieve verifiable evidence citations.
